nudge.body: Every request starts with the same 49k tokens: system prompt, CLAUDE.md, tool schemas, skills and plugins. Even as a cache read that costs about $0.37 a turn at 15 calls per turn. The largest part is built-in tools (schemas) (12k tokens). /context shows what fills it, and i on cctop's Context panel breaks the prefix down. Then trim CLAUDE.md, move rarely used rules into skills, and turn off the MCP servers (/mcp) and plugins (/plugin) this project doesn't use.
nudge.explain: The fixed prefix (system prompt, CLAUDE.md, tool schemas, skills, plugins) is sent on every request. Even as a cache read it is billed on every call, so its cost per turn is prefix × cache-read price × calls per turn; it fires from 50 k tokens whatever the window, because the cost is absolute — once a /context you ran has measured the prefix, since the first call's own figure overstates it by about a third. Trim CLAUDE.md, move rarely used rules into skills, and disable MCP servers and plugins you do not use in this project. On the Context panel, i breaks the prefix down and m shows what else fills the window.
